A terminal transcript frame may arrive before the saved boundary. The scoped refresh asks the server for its updated detail and the command still independently revalidates continuation. Exact local Chromium source passed all three external-session cases with generated Claude and Codex files.

Reviewed the follow read, queued metadata commit and event publication. A real changed completed boundary triggers one projection refresh after the accepted row lands. Idle, cursor-only changes, refused updates and replay cannot generate this refresh. The real SQLite keeper failed with no notification before the repair and passes with the recorded boundary visible to its listener. The current-main isolated idle benchmark is separate from hosted or installed-runtime evidence.

Generic progress and list-only frames use the existing throttled list refresh. Focused scope checks and the mounted Codex disabled-to-enabled sequence passed.
